title: Interview: planning rules
lead: Settle how the weekly plan works day to day (ADR 0013).

sections.heading: Why
sections.body: The suggestion engine and the planning UI are mostly these rules.

sections.heading: Owner input
sections.body:
1. Planning day and time (e.g., Saturday morning before ordering)?
2. How many dinners per week (default 5)? Which nights are leftovers, takeout or open?
3. Recency: minimum days before repeating a meal (e.g., 10)? Weight kid favorites higher?
4. Skipped meal: roll it to the next open night (recommended), or return it to the pool?
5. Effort balance: limit "project" meals to weeknights or weekends?
6. Does a non-technical household member plan too, or only see the result?
7. Breakfast/lunch (e.g., overnight oats): plan them, or only add their ingredients as staples?

sections.heading: Implement
sections.body:
1. Ask the questions with recommendations.
2. Amend ADR 0013 with the rules; record the raw answers in `local/` (not committed).
3. Update the ranking, planning session and Today view slices (`slicer edit`).

sections.heading: Check
sections.body:
- ADR 0013 lists the concrete rules with numbers.
- The dependent slices are updated.

sections.heading: Git
sections.body: Commit only when the owner asks; no AI attribution.
